title.it: Un libro di scuola: i plurali irregolari

intro.en: This is my favourite page: the plurals that don't follow the rule!
intro.sl: To je moja najljubša stran: množine, ki ne sledijo pravilu!
intro.it: Questa è la mia pagina preferita: i plurali che non seguono la regola!
intro.de: Das ist meine Lieblingsseite: die Pluralformen, die sich nicht an die Regel halten!

text.en: In English, most nouns add -s in the plural: one book, two books.
text.sl: V angleščini večina samostalnikov v množini dobi -s: one book, two books.
text.it: In inglese quasi tutti i nomi prendono una -s al plurale: one book, two books.
text.de: Im Englischen bekommen die meisten Nomen im Plural ein -s: one book, two books.

text.en: But some nouns are different. We call them irregular.
text.sl: Nekateri samostalniki pa so drugačni. Pravimo jim nepravilni.
text.it: Ma alcuni nomi sono diversi. Li chiamiamo irregolari.
text.de: Aber manche Nomen sind anders. Wir nennen sie unregelmäßig.

text.en: One sheep, two sheep: the plural of “sheep” is “sheep”. Never “sheeps”!
text.sl: One sheep, two sheep (ena ovca, dve ovci): množina besede »sheep« je »sheep«. Nikoli »sheeps«!
text.it: One sheep, two sheep (una pecora, due pecore): il plurale di »sheep« è »sheep«. Mai »sheeps«!
text.de: One sheep, two sheep (ein Schaf, zwei Schafe): Der Plural von »sheep« ist »sheep«. Nie »sheeps«!

text.en: “Fish” and “deer” are the same: one fish, ten fish.
text.sl: Enako je pri »fish« (riba) in »deer« (jelen): one fish, ten fish.
text.it: Lo stesso vale per »fish« (pesce) e »deer« (cervo): one fish, ten fish.
text.de: Genauso ist es bei »fish« (Fisch) und »deer« (Hirsch): one fish, ten fish.

text.en: Some nouns change their vowel: one man, two men; one woman, two women.
text.sl: Nekateri samostalniki spremenijo samoglasnik: one man, two men (moški); one woman, two women (ženska).
text.it: Alcuni nomi cambiano la vocale: one man, two men (uomo); one woman, two women (donna).
text.de: Manche Nomen ändern ihren Vokal: one man, two men (Mann); one woman, two women (Frau).

text.en: One foot, two feet; one tooth, two teeth; one goose, two geese.
text.sl: One foot, two feet (stopalo); one tooth, two teeth (zob); one goose, two geese (gos).
text.it: One foot, two feet (piede); one tooth, two teeth (dente); one goose, two geese (oca).
text.de: One foot, two feet (Fuß); one tooth, two teeth (Zahn); one goose, two geese (Gans).

text.en: One mouse, two mice. Poppy's cat, Tibbs, catches a lot of mice!
text.sl: One mouse, two mice (miš). Poppy ima mačko Tibbs, ki ulovi veliko miši!
text.it: One mouse, two mice (topo). Tibbs, il gatto di Poppy, prende tanti topi!
text.de: One mouse, two mice (Maus). Tibbs, Poppys Katze, fängt viele Mäuse!

text.en: One child, two children. One person, two people.
text.sl: One child, two children (otrok). One person, two people (oseba, ljudje).
text.it: One child, two children (bambino). One person, two people (persona, persone).
text.de: One child, two children (Kind). One person, two people (Person, Leute).

text.en: Some nouns ending in -f or -fe change to -ves: one knife, two knives; one loaf, two loaves; one wolf, two wolves.
text.sl: Nekateri samostalniki na -f ali -fe dobijo -ves: one knife, two knives (nož); one loaf, two loaves (hlebec); one wolf, two wolves (volk).
text.it: Alcuni nomi che finiscono in -f o -fe prendono -ves: one knife, two knives (coltello); one loaf, two loaves (pagnotta); one wolf, two wolves (lupo).
text.de: Manche Nomen auf -f oder -fe bekommen -ves: one knife, two knives (Messer); one loaf, two loaves (Brotlaib); one wolf, two wolves (Wolf).

text.en: Why? These words are very old. In Old English, there were many ways to make a plural. Only these few words kept the old way.
text.sl: Zakaj? Te besede so zelo stare. V stari angleščini je bilo veliko načinov za množino. Samo teh nekaj besed je ohranilo stari način.
text.it: Perché? Queste parole sono molto antiche. Nell'inglese antico c'erano tanti modi per fare il plurale. Solo queste poche parole hanno tenuto il modo antico.
text.de: Warum? Diese Wörter sind sehr alt. Im Altenglischen gab es viele Arten, den Plural zu bilden. Nur diese wenigen Wörter haben die alte Art behalten.

text.en: Learn them by heart and say them out loud: sheep, men, women, feet, teeth, geese, mice, children, people, knives!
text.sl: Nauči se jih na pamet in jih povej na glas: sheep, men, women, feet, teeth, geese, mice, children, people, knives!
text.it: Imparali a memoria e dilli ad alta voce: sheep, men, women, feet, teeth, geese, mice, children, people, knives!
text.de: Lern sie auswendig und sag sie laut: sheep, men, women, feet, teeth, geese, mice, children, people, knives!

ask.en: Mr Tyson has a hundred … Which word is right?
ask.sl: Gospod Tyson ima sto … Katera beseda je pravilna?
ask.it: Il signor Tyson ha cento … Quale parola è giusta?
ask.de: Herr Tyson hat hundert … Welches Wort ist richtig?

explain.en: “Sheep” doesn't change: one sheep, a hundred sheep.
explain.sl: »Sheep« se ne spremeni: one sheep, a hundred sheep.
explain.it: »Sheep« non cambia: one sheep, a hundred sheep.
explain.de: »Sheep« ändert sich nicht: one sheep, a hundred sheep.

explain.en: One mouse, two mice: the word changes inside, like foot and feet.
explain.sl: One mouse, two mice: beseda se spremeni v sredini, kot foot in feet.
explain.it: One mouse, two mice: la parola cambia dentro, come foot e feet.
explain.de: One mouse, two mice: Das Wort ändert sich innen, wie foot und feet.

explain.en: “Knife” ends in -fe, so the plural is “knives”, like loaf and loaves.
explain.sl: »Knife« se konča na -fe, zato je množina »knives«, kot loaf in loaves.
explain.it: »Knife« finisce in -fe, quindi il plurale è »knives«, come loaf e loaves.
explain.de: »Knife« endet auf -fe, also ist der Plural »knives«, wie loaf und loaves.
